The FixerResult intentionally remains BLOCKED pending exact-SHA device performance QA; this does not negate independently verified static engineering checks.

Before evaluating results, independent shasum -a 256 returned exactly b224cd5470efb70e1de7d63f9361f7269835e4bf7adaa53123e76d67dfe24173 for build/TapBuild/game.zip. The archive is 1,206,608 bytes, below 20 MB, and unzip -tq reported no compressed-data errors. It was not rebuilt, repackaged, modified or uploaded.

The exact ZIP contains root game.js, game.json and project.config.json. game.json declares portrait and productVersion 1.0.0; project.config.json declares compileType game, appid 928932 and projectname 疯狂切割. ZIP src/settings.json declares launch scene main, designResolution 390x844, policy 4 and the project script bundle.

Independent hashing of the retained official TapTap plugin 1.2.2 archive returned 6b8a9a3cc62b6c54cefab397097babb771d9d99f90442cddff06310a4c9ed73f, and installed extensions/taptap-minigame-tools/package.json identifies TapTap version 1.2.2. The earlier immutable plugin-integrity evidence records byte-for-byte equality; no plugin source change is claimed by this repair.

Independent inspection of the exact ZIP assets/main/index.js found separate staticGraphics and dynamicGraphics layers. Lifecycle start calls redrawStaticCourse once and redrawDynamicCourse once; the airborne update calls redrawDynamicCourse only, and dynamic redraw clears only the dynamic layer. performance-contract.json specifies staticCourseDrawsPerLifecycle=1, dynamicDrawsPerActiveFrame=1 and staticDrawsPerActiveFrame=0. This proves the engineering contract and packaged implementation, not device FPS.

The exact ZIP's compiled GameBootstrap includes 390x844 FIXED_WIDTH and safe-area setup, Graphics first-frame drawing, TOUCH_END handling, launch/flip, cut, reflect, hazard/fall failure, finish settlement and terminal-touch replay. These are structural/deterministic proxies only and were not counted as natural-device or perceptual evidence.

Independent read-only execution from platforms/taptap-minigame passed: pnpm test reported 16 tests, 16 pass, 0 fail; pnpm lint exited 0; pnpm typecheck exited 0. No Cocos build or converter was invoked.

performance-baseline.json and performance-after.json document a deterministic source-work proxy: at a nominal 60 Hz ten-minute window, full-scene redraws decrease from 36,000 to 0 and repeated static fill/stroke operations from approximately 648,000 to 0, while dynamic redraws remain 36,000. Both artifacts explicitly set deviceFpsMeasured=false or identify the measurement as a source-work proxy; 0.02150376 remains an unconfirmed root-cause signal and no TapTap FPS threshold is invented.
